Teaching focus

The classical model was originally proposed for emotion (1937); modern research emphasizes memory, navigation, attention and interactions with broader cortical networks.

2022–2026 updates

The anterior thalamic nuclei are active network hubs, not merely passive relay stations. Distinct anterior thalamic subdomains connect to different cognitive and emotional systems. Episodic memory depends on distributed, recurrent networks.
